wait_cause: services/source_ingestion/snapshot_universe.py snapshot_for_request took self._lock (universe RLock) and ran maybe_sweep() in finally; sweep() holds the same lock across store.withdraw_symbols (journal compaction). store.get is lock-free in journal mode (requirement_state.py LatestMarketSnapshotStore.get), so the universe lock is what every reader waited on.

change.request_path: snapshot_for_request no longer calls sweep/maybe_sweep; stored snapshot lookup uses non-blocking lock acquire and defers the recency touch if the lock is busy (applied by next lookup or the sweep); a lookup that must seed takes the lock and waits for a sweep in progress (tested).
change.schedule: SnapshotUniverse.start_background_sweeps: one daemon thread per process, 3600 s cadence, first wait a full interval after the PR 7589 startup sweep; started from runtime after _warm_snapshot_lookup; stopped via atexit/stop_background_sweeps. Sweep semantics unchanged.

not_measured_here: Hosted shaped before/after longest-lookup measurement (acceptance 5) was not run in this worker (no hosted copy access); coordinator repeats the 65 minute 1 s sampler after deploy, expecting no lookup above 3 s outside a restart.
